summary: All five fresh 6.29M-transition arms completed. Orthogonal-sqrt2 backbone initialization was the only single reversion to cross the preregistered collapse threshold.

observed: Training 500 levels, reward-normalizer gamma 0.999 and whole-batch advantage normalization did not lower final-256 quality versus the same-run reference.
Orthogonal-sqrt2 initialization lowered mean return by 2.34375 and success rate by 0.234375 versus reference.
interpretation: Orthogonal-sqrt2 initialization is an independently dominant early-sample-efficiency factor under this one-seed 6.29M-transition protocol.
not_established: That initialization alone explains every part of the historical 25.17M degradation.
That orthogonal initialization is a software implementation bug rather than a weaker training choice for this architecture and budget.
Multi-seed effect size or long-horizon 25.17M attribution.
decision: Run CR-PPO-0004 to re-evaluate the historical checkpoint under the aligned metric and test all old settings combined before closing attribution.
Do not collect trajectories or start dynamics.
